notes: A no-sound message. When a file's audio is Dolby Digital, Dolby Digital Plus, DTS or TrueHD, which a browser engine cannot decode, the player now says so while the picture plays and points you to a stream with AAC audio; the Audio menu says it too. From the same day: stream rows an add-on marks as not playable in a browser say so and sit below the rest, a stream that cannot play explains itself in words, audio tracks are named by language, F11 goes fullscreen, a dropped file plays, and watch parties always reach the relay that is running. On Windows, add-ons, profile, settings and progress now survive closing the app.
